All project inputs and outputs must use only topic tags and your own notes. They must never include actual or paraphrased question text from UWorld, Archer, Kaplan, or another paid question bank. Every plan must stay within PN scope of practice: reinforce, monitor, report, and follow the care plan. Gamification, streaks, and leaderboards remain parked under the governing rules.

**Still owed before sharing with your study group:** someone with a nursing background must check *every* plan template for scope-of-practice wording. That review has not happened.
